references.text: Introduces Achan's sin and explains why he had to be judged
Continuation of the story where Achan and his family are stoned and burned in the Valley of Achor
Reference back to Achan's unfaithfulness and how it affected all Israel
Achan from the line of Zerah is mentioned in David's genealogy
The Valley of Achor is mentioned as a place of hope, in contrast to the judgment on Achan
The law that children should not die for their fathers' sin, which seems to be in tension with this event
Parallel to Korah's judgment where the whole family was affected along with the sinners
God's principle of visiting the sins of the fathers upon the children
